response.justification: Bogdan is a highly experienced, versatile engineer with strong full-stack, DevOps, and D-language expertise, plus notable geospatial/GIS background through GISCollective and Green Map. However, the role requires deep, current C++ or Rust expertise for a routing tiling pipeline, and his recent C++ experience is over a decade old (2014-2015), with the vast majority of his career focused on JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js, and D. He lacks demonstrated experience with distributed-system fault tolerance, service discovery, or navigation guidance QA at production scale.
strengths: Long-standing personal and professional experience building geospatial/GIS platforms (GISCollective, Green Map)
Broad technical versatility across web, mobile, embedded, and systems programming, showing adaptability
Strong track record of software craftsmanship practices (TDD, CI/CD) and mentoring/teaching others
concerns: Core C++ experience is outdated (last used ~2014-2015) and not a primary skill in recent roles
No listed Rust experience, and no recent experience with distributed systems concepts like fault tolerance or service discovery
No evidence of building production navigation/routing pipelines or working with real-time traffic data at scale

key_factors.factor: Outdated/limited C++ and no Rust experience
Lack of distributed systems and navigation-specific production experience
